entries.name: Git
entries.summary: Workspace + repo browsing: list branches, stage / commit / push, read diffs and history. Studio's source-of-truth for the active workspace path.

entries.name: Claude Code
entries.summary: Run a Claude Code CLI session against the active workspace and stream the agent loop back into Studio's transcript.

entries.name: Google Sheets (service account)
entries.summary: Create / read / modify Google Sheets via a service account. Files are owned by the SA — best for headless or scheduled jobs.

entries.name: Google Sheets (OAuth)
entries.summary: Create / read / modify Google Sheets as the authenticated user. Files live in your personal Drive — best for interactive use.
